jobs.description: Qui sommes-nous ? Fondée en 2014, Artefact est une société française de services autour de la data, spécialisée dans le conseil en IA, transformation data et en data & digital marketing. L’approche unique d’Artefact, qui fait le pont entre la donnée et le business, permet à nos clients d’atteindre leurs objectifs business de façon dédiée et efficace. Nos 2500 collaborateurs répartis dans 27 bureaux à travers le monde allient leurs compétences pluridisciplinaires au profit de l’innovation business des entreprises.  La mission des Artefactors ? Transformer la data de nos clients en impact business. Dans ce sens, nous collaborons avec plus de 1000 clients, leaders de leurs industries (Orange, Carrefour, Samsung, AccorHotels, L’Oréal, LVMH, Decathlon) et sommes partenaires privilégiés de Google (GMP/GCP), AWS ainsi que Microsoft Azure.  En tant que stagiaire Data Scientist, tu seras responsable de :  La réalisation de projets de données (sécurisation de la livraison de vos projets)   La communication de ton travail et réalisations au sein de l’équipe Travailler en étroite collaboration avec ton homologue conseil pour établir et entretenir des relations solides avec vos clients et mieux comprendre leurs besoins  S’assurer que tes solutions apportent des valeurs à la problématique client   Rechercher et développer de nouvelles approches techniques pour résoudre efficacement les problèmes Partager les bonnes pratiques et contribuer aux connaissances institutionnelles d’Artefact   Tu es ?   Tu es étudiant(e) en dernière année de cycle ingénieur, Master 2, ou équivalent, avec une spécialisation en Data Science, Intelligence Artificielle, Mathématiques appliquées, Statistiques ou Informatique. Tu es à la recherche d un stage de fin d études de 6 mois à partir de janvier  2027 . Tu possèdes une bonne compréhension de l écosystème numérique et data et de ses technologies : web analytique, programmatique, DMP,

jobs.title: Data Scientist Marketing
jobs.description: At bunq, we’re on a mission to Make Life Easy for our users by creating the most user-centric banking experience out there. Our paid marketing campaigns run on predictions about which new users will turn out to be valuable. This role makes sure those predictions are right. That’s where you come in. As our Data Scientist, Marketing , you’ll own the machine learning models that predict the value of every newly verified user and feed that value into Google Ads, so our campaigns find more users like them. If the models are off, the spend is off. AI can help you write and debug code, but it can’t build the model or judge whether the output can be trusted. That judgment is yours. Take Ownership 🚀 You’ll own the predictive models that steer our marketing spend. Here’s how you’ll do it: Build, maintain and expand the predictive models for marketing, from first idea to production, starting with the models that predict each new user’s value in their first 90 days. Hit the model quality targets within 9 months: a Spearman rank correlation of 0.50 or higher and a binary model AUC of 0.75 or higher. Keep the models running in production and monitor data and model health to find where to intervene, using Claude Code to move faster and validating everything it produces. You’ve built predictive models with traditional machine learning, such as XGBoost. You’ve written Python and built the data pipelines a model needs, including when none existed. You’ve shipped ML models to production and kept them running. You’ve done deep dives into data and model health to find what needs intervention. You use AI tools like Claude Code in your daily work and know where they stop. You are fluent in English. Curious to see how we make life easy? - try the bunq app , it only takes 5 minutes to sign up. jobs.title: FDE Data Engineer- Space (FedD141/FedD147)
jobs.description: EMPLOYER IS A CONTRACTOR FOR THE U.S. GOVERNMENT. THIS POSITION WILL REQUIRE U.S. CITIZENSHIP. Role Description This is a forward-deployed engineering role. You'll work shoulder-to-shoulder with mission heroes: the users, operators, and program engineers who run real workloads in real DoD environments. You'll help take UDS Data Capability from "deployable" to "running in production under classification." You will deploy, integrate, and operate our data stack in the mission hero's environment alongside senior engineers, then carry what you learn back into the product so the next engagement is easier. The scope of this work varies by engagement. Some programs require standing up a governed data platform to centralize sensor or operational data from known sources, where the problem is well-defined and the priority is building and shipping. Others involve consolidating data across hundreds of interconnected government systems of record with overlapping schemas, deeply interdependent data flows, and significant architectural complexity. You should be comfortable building independently against defined problems and growing into more ambiguous, complex engagements over time. Forward-deployed means aligned with the mission hero, not always on a plane. Most of the work is remote. You'll travel to sites when the engagement calls for it: initial standup, integration work, incident response, training and knowledge transfer. The rest of the time, you'll be on a video call or in a shared chat with that same mission hero. The role is defined by the relationship with the mission hero, not by where you sit. You are a data engineer who can build across the breadth of a data platform (storage, ingestion, streaming, governance, and access) and deliver working solutions in constrained, mission-critical environments. Responsibilities Deploy and configure UDS Data Capability in the mission hero's environment. Stand up the UDS Store (Iceberg, Rook/Ceph, pgvector, Postgres), wire up UDS Tran

jobs.title: Senior Data Engineer
jobs.description: About Orakl Oncology At Orakl Oncology, we are accelerating the development of oncology treatments. Today, fewer than 5% of new cancer drugs succeed in clinical trials. Clearly, new methods are needed. We combine cutting-edge biology and AI to build the next generation of insight platforms with the world’s largest cohort of patient tumor avatars. These avatars fuel our AI-powered predictive engine , helping to anticipate clinical trial outcomes, validate therapies, and uncover new drug candidates. By generating multimodal, real-world data, we deliver insights that consistently outperform existing solutions. Our mission is simple yet ambitious: to bring more effective treatments to patients who need them and to make drug development smarter, faster, and more personalized. We collaborate with top hospitals, research institutes, and pharmaceutical companies worldwide. Backed by leading investors, we are a fast-growing, mission-driven startup at the intersection of science and technology. The role We are looking for a curious engineering mind to lead the scaling of Orakl’s omics data within the Computational Biology team. Every organoid grown in our lab is sequenced (WGS and RNA-seq). Our pipelines turn the raw reads into processed molecular profiles, and our models turn those profiles into clinical trial predictions, patient segments and new target candidates. Your mission will be to make omics data available to computational biologists and research engineers in a form they can build on. You will gather their needs and, in coordination with the Data & Infra team, design the data representations, storage layouts and access patterns that make model training and experimentation fast and reproducible. As our biobank expands, this will become a massive omics corpus that must efficiently serve client contracts, strategic partnerships and internal R&D projects.
